blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Czarnikow has clients in many countries. We work with Brazil, India, China, the UK, the US, Germany and Thailand. Each country is a new word in English.

Today we learn five words: client, country, world, global and partner. We also learn plurals. Most words add s: one client, two clients. Some words add es: one box, two boxes. A few are irregular: one country, two countries.

Czarnikow has offices around the world. Our partners are global. Brazilian sugar goes to India, China and Europe. We are a global team with one goal.

items.q: How many clients does Czarnikow have?
items.why: "Czarnikow has clients in many countries."

items.q: What is the plural of "country"?
items.why: Country é irregular: troca -y por -ies → countries.

items.q: Where does Brazilian sugar go?
items.why: "Brazilian sugar goes to India, China and Europe."

items.q: The text suggests that Czarnikow is…
options: a new company with no clients
items.why: Inferência: clientes em muitos países + "offices around the world" + "a global team" mostram que é global.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: learning country names is helpful for the job
Czarnikow works in only one country
English is not useful at work
items.why: Inferência: o texto ensina países e diz "Each country is a new word" — aprender os nomes ajuda no trabalho.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Ethan mostrando o mapa do mundo. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning! Look at this map. It shows our clients around the world. Each pin is a country.

Here is Brazil. This is a very big market for us. We sell a lot of sugar here. Next to it, look here, this is the US, and up here is the UK. These are old partners.

Now look at Asia. Here is India, and this one is China. They are big buyers too. And down here, this small pin, is Thailand.

So we have clients in many countries. We have partners on every continent. We are a global team. That is why English is so important. When you speak to a client in Germany or a partner in China, you use English.

Please look at the map every day. Learn the countries. Learn the words. One client, two clients. One country, two countries. It is easy. Thank you!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does the map show?
items.why: "It shows our clients around the world."

items.q: What does each pin on the map mean?
items.why: "Each pin is a country."

items.q: Why is English important, according to Ethan?
options: Because the map is in English
Because you speak to clients and partners in many countries
Because the office is in the UK
Because sugar is sold in English
items.why: "When you speak to a client in Germany or a partner in China, you use English."

items.q: Ethan suggests that the new trader should…
options: study the map and learn the countries
items.why: Inferência: "Please look at the map every day. Learn the countries."

items.q: How would you describe Ethan's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "It is easy", dá boas-vindas e agradece — tom amigável e encorajador.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "India is a new client for us." A client is…
options: a person or company that buys from us
items.why: Client = cliente: quem compra de nós.

items.q: "Brazil is a big country." A country is…
options: a nation, like Brazil or China
items.why: Country = país.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We have offices around the ___."
items.why: "Around the world" = ao redor do mundo.

items.q: "Our partners are global." Global means…
items.why: Global = do mundo todo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "China is an important business ___ for Czarnikow."
items.why: Partner = parceiro (de negócios).

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We work with clients around the world." This means…
items.why: Around the world = pelo mundo todo, em muitos países.

items.q: "Let's roll out the plan in Brazil first." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = lançar, colocar em prática.

items.q: "Can you reach out to the client in India?" To reach out to means to…
items.why: Reach out to = entrar em contato com.

items.q: "The boss will sign off on the new partner." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We deal with clients in seven countries." To deal with means to…
items.why: Deal with = lidar/trabalhar com.
